content: Primary-source GitHub issues show recurring router bugs: forced anthropic-beta rewrite corrupts tool_use (OmniRoute #3415); fabricated/stale thinking signatures cause 400 cascades across combos (#14671, #7899); system-role hoisting moves cache_control (#9436); OpenAI-format usage drops cached_tokens (#10535) and empty-choices usage chunk dropped (#11817); empty tool args replayed as input "" poison history (#14798); </think> leaked as content (#5123); cache affinity silently reorders priority combos (#8370); random Antigravity sessionId kills upstream cache (#13305); LiteLLM drops signature-only thinking (#41361), message-level cache_control on list content (#43324), moves tool_result cache_control (#41954), leaks message_start before double-failed fallback (#38610), maps model_context_window_exceeded to stop (#43012).
